exposure: RCOG RAM risk categories (low, intermediate, high)
cohort: The study participants consisted of 38 Chinese women who experienced postpartum VTE and 152 Chinese women without VTE who gave birth on the same day, all recruited from the International Peace Maternity and Child Health Hospital.
finding: The RCOG RAM effectively predicted postpartum VTE in Chinese women, showing significantly increased risks in intermediate-risk and high-risk groups, with glucocorticoid therapy during pregnancy and previous IUD use identified as additional risk factors.
